summary: UI-1-A viewable-build addendum (2026-07-31) verified. Four demo identities log in successfully with expected roles (master_admin / dpo / operator / ask_console_user). New GET /api/use_data/sessions returns {in_progress[], ready[]} envelopes carrying per-row is_sample flag. Each demo identity sees exactly 1 in_progress sample (door=integrate_an_app) + 1 ready sample (door=export_or_license, verdict_ref=trcv-sample-ready-export-license-fixture) — 8 sample docs total across 4 identities. GET /api/use_data/session/{id} exposes top-level is_sample=true for samples, false for fresh sessions. Reflection card carries 3 SET, 1 ASSUMED (rights=internal_plus_partner), 1 OPEN (output_form). Mongo-backed durability confirmed: opened a fresh POST /api/use_data/session {door:'train_a_model'}, restarted backend via supervisorctl, GET returned the session with is_sample=false. Idempotent seeder does NOT duplicate on restart — sample count stays 8. Cross-operator scoping enforced (operator ∩ dpo = ∅). Addendum test suite tests/test_use_data_iter12_addendum.py = 12/12 PASS; iter11 regression tests/test_use_data_http_iter11.py = 14/14 PASS (parity 36/36 confirmed via /api/readyz + /api/system/build_info). Frontend desktop @1920x1080: /use-data landing renders 3 doors + pipeline strip with 1 in-progress + 1 ready row, SAMPLE badge visible on both, NO wizard sample banner on landing (banner is wizard-only). Clicking sample row navigates to /use-data/wizard/s-sample-in-progress-* and renders SAMPLE FIXTURE · This is seeded demo data (AS-U2). It is not a live commission. banner; all 6 cards render (reflection/intel/test/plan-preview/sample-results/commission) with pre-seeded fields (coverage 68-82, cost 420-740, ceiling 1000); the 2 dialogue turns (USER 'Need a scoring API over our licensed customer utterances.' + AGENT 'I hear you...') render on the right pane. Frontend mobile @390x844: landing renders correctly (3 doors stacked, pipeline strip below, SAMPLE badges visible, no horizontal scroll). Ask Console at / also renders correctly on mobile (no overflow, console-nav-toggle present). HOWEVER — the wizard page at /use-data/wizard/* has horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth=495 vs clientWidth=390); the 40/60 split-view is not collapsing to a single column on mobile widths — the six cards stack, SAMPLE banner is visible above the fold, but the layout requires a horizontal scroll to see the dialogue pane. Non-blocking for the addendum but flag-worthy design issue.

minor.issue: STALE-DATA HAZARD: some Mongo docs in use_data_wizard_sessions carry a stray {'instance_id':'instance_1'} field that is NOT part of the frozen UseDataWizardSession contract (extra='forbid'). Reading such a doc raises pydantic ValidationError → 500. Root cause is unclear (no code path in current tree writes instance_id to this collection; likely legacy migration residue), but during a full pytest run I observed 8/8 sample docs re-acquire the field mid-suite, breaking subsequent reads. WORKAROUND applied for this iter: manual `db.use_data_wizard_sessions.update_many({instance_id:{'$exists':true}}, {$unset:{instance_id:''}})` + restart. RECOMMENDED FIX (main agent): make session_store._from_doc tolerant (`stripped = {k:v for k,v in doc.items() if k in UseDataWizardSession.model_fields}`) — this hardens the read path against ANY sidecar residue and makes the persistence layer non-brittle.

issues: Horizontal overflow present (scrollWidth=495 > clientWidth=390). Six cards stack vertically and the SAMPLE banner is visible above the fold, but the split-view layout (40/60 cards | dialogue) does not collapse to single-column on mobile widths; the right dialogue pane sits off-screen requiring horizontal scroll. Landing + Ask Console mobile layouts are fine.

action_items: Harden /app/backend/services/use_data/session_store.py::_from_doc to tolerate unexpected sidecar fields in the persisted doc (whitelist by UseDataWizardSession.model_fields instead of blacklisting _id + is_sample only). This makes the read path robust against future schema drift and against the current 'instance_id' residue that intermittently reappears in test runs.

Investigate the source of the 'instance_id':'instance_1' field on use_data_wizard_sessions docs — no code path in the current tree writes it, but it re-appears during full pytest runs. Suspect a legacy migration hook or a scoped_accessor call reaching the wrong collection. If it is truly legacy residue, add a startup migration to $unset it once (idempotent).
OPTIONAL: on mobile widths (<640px) collapse the /use-data/wizard/* split-view to a single column so the dialogue pane stacks BELOW the cards rather than overflowing horizontally.
critical_code_review_comments: session_store._from_doc uses a stop-list ({_id, is_sample}) rather than a fields-whitelist — this is the direct cause of the 500 error class described above; any extra field in the persistence doc becomes a hard read failure. Whitelisting from the model would be a one-line hardening.

The addendum requires four demo identities but the seed_demo_identities_if_absent path is idempotent — good. However there is no data-integrity guard against future contract-field-removal breaking the read path for existing docs; recommend a schema-version tag on each persistence doc for graceful migration.
React Router v6 future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) still fire on every navigation — carried over from iter11 close report. One-line fix on <BrowserRouter>.
UseDataWizardPage.jsx still ~764 lines (from iter11 close report); split threshold breached. Non-blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter12 verified the Owner viewable-build addendum. Key finding: /app/backend/services/use_data/session_store.py::_from_doc is brittle against sidecar fields on persistence docs — a stray 'instance_id':'instance_1' currently exists on 8 sample docs and intermittently reappears during full pytest runs, causing 500 errors. Workaround: `db.use_data_wizard_sessions.update_many({instance_id:{'$exists':true}},{$unset:{instance_id:''}})` then restart backend. Proper fix: whitelist fields from UseDataWizardSession.model_fields in _from_doc. Frozen contract parity remains 36/36. Addendum regression pack at /app/backend/tests/test_use_data_iter12_addendum.py — use it alongside test_use_data_http_iter11.py for /api/use_data/* coverage going forward.
rca of the issue: 500 on GET /api/use_data/sessions & GET /api/use_data/session/{id}: some persisted docs in Mongo collection use_data_wizard_sessions carry an unexpected 'instance_id':'instance_1' field. The frozen UseDataWizardSession Pydantic model uses ConfigDict(extra='forbid'), so session_store._from_doc(doc) — which strips only {_id, is_sample} before rehydrating — raises ValidationError('Extra inputs are not permitted [instance_id]'), which FastAPI converts to a 500. Repro: seed the collection (backend startup does this idempotently), then $set instance_id='instance_1' on any sample doc, then GET /api/use_data/sessions → 500. Mitigation applied: manual $unset + restart. Recommended production fix: change session_store._from_doc to whitelist fields from UseDataWizardSession.model_fields (which naturally excludes ANY sidecar residue) rather than blacklisting a fixed pair; that makes the read path resilient to schema drift AND to any latent code path (which I could not locate in the current tree) that may be re-adding the field.
